app_description: AI-Powered Mythology & Folk Story Video Factory — Scanned PDF OCR, LLM story segmentation, 6-beat script generation, Hindi/regional TTS narration, AI image/motion rendering, 9:16 Shorts/Reels video assembly, and automated QA & human approval workflow.
theme: Dark Cinematic Cyber-Mythic (Deep Obsidian #090A0F, Warm Sacred Amber #F59E0B, Crimson Flame #EF4444, Mystic Temple Indigo #1E1B4B)
design_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO x MYTHIC EDITORIAL (High-density video factory dashboard with rich parchment & glowing jewel-tone accents for folklore storytelling)

typography.heading_font: Cinematic Serif & Heavy Display Sans (Playfair Display / Serif, bold tight tracking)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans / Inter for crisp dashboard UI
typography.script_mono_font: JetBrains Mono / Fira Code for prompt & metadata editing

Batch Actions: Trigger 6-Beat Script Generation, Send to Audio TTS Pipeline, Export PDF Report
Interactive 6-Beat Story Script Editor (Hook, Story, Twist, Climax, Action, Lesson) with color-coded segment cards

Human Review Workflow Actions Bar (Approve for Export, Request Edits with Segment Commenting, Reject Story)
Publishing Metadata Studio (Viral YouTube Shorts/Reels Title, Description, Hashtag Generator, Thumbnail Selector, 9:16 MP4 Download)
Channel 1 & Channel 2 Tabbed Configuration Studio
Voice & Narration Preset Selector (Hindi Deep Epic vs Bengali Warm Folk Narrator)
Background Music Preset Selector & Audio Volume Balance Sliders
Safety & Guardrails Strictness Controls (Gore/Violence Filter, Mythic Reverence Filter)
Watermark & Branding Overlay Controls (Logo placement, 9:16 canvas crop rules)

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers (e.g. data-testid='upload-pdf-dropzone', data-testid='beat-segment-card-hook', data-testid='approve-story-button')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rules: Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast ratio over dark obsidian backgrounds. Primary buttons use dark text (#090A0F) over high-contrast Amber (#F59E0B) or Emerald (#10B981) background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build StoryForge as a rich, multi-view AI video factory web application in JavaScript React.

Implement the 5 main views: Production Dashboard, PDF Upload & OCR Engine, Books & Extracted Stories Library, Story Factory & Script Studio (with 6 color-coded beats, 9:16 player, TTS preview, QA report, approval workflow, metadata generator), and Channel Settings Editor.
Ensure all 6 narrative beats (Hook, Story, Twist, Climax, Action, Lesson) are prominently color-coded with badges, audio previews, visual prompts, and motion controls.
Use Recharts for the API Cost per Video breakdown and Job Queue Health analytics.
Support two independently configurable channels ('Mythic Shorts - Dramatic' and 'Folk Tales - Whimsical') with channel switcher in the top navigation bar.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, card, and action element includes explicit `data-testid` attributes as specified in testing_and_accessibility.
Integrate the Unsplash image URLs provided in design_guidelines.json into the video segment previews, thumbnails, and story cards.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not create generic centered white/gray card layouts. Use deep obsidian dark theme with amber and jewel-tone accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not apply transition: all globally. Apply targeted CSS transitions to hover and active states.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_center_container: Do not set text-align: center on root app containers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.custom_scrollbars: Ensure sleek dark scrollbars with rounded thumbs and translucent tracks.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testids: All buttons, tabs, dropdowns, inputs, and status badges MUST have valid kebab-case data-testid attributes.
